title: LSA of Cube
description: Calculates the total area of the four side faces of a cube.

example.question: Find the lateral surface area of a cube with side 6 cm.

note: A cube has four lateral faces.

title: TSA of Cube
description: Calculates the total area of all six faces of a cube.

example.question: Find the total surface area of a cube with side 6 cm.

note: A cube has six equal square faces.

title: LSA of Cuboid
description: Calculates the total area of the four side faces of a cuboid.

example.question: Find the lateral surface area of a cuboid with length 10 cm, breadth 6 cm and height 8 cm.

note: Lateral surface area excludes the top and bottom faces.

title: TSA of Cuboid
description: Calculates the total area of all six faces of a cuboid.

example.question: Find the total surface area of a cuboid with length 10 cm, breadth 6 cm and height 8 cm.

note: A cuboid has six rectangular faces.

title: CSA of Cylinder
description: Calculates the area of the curved surface of a cylinder.

example.question: Find the curved surface area of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm.

note: Curved surface area excludes the circular bases.

title: TSA of Cylinder
description: Calculates the total area of the curved surface and the two circular bases of a cylinder.

example.question: Find the total surface area of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm.

note: Total surface area = Curved surface area + Area of two circular bases.

title: CSA of Cone
description: Calculates the area of the curved surface of a cone using its radius and slant height.

example.question: Find the curved surface area of a cone with radius 7 cm and slant height 12 cm.

note: Curved surface area excludes the circular base.

title: TSA of Cone
description: Calculates the total area of the curved surface and the circular base of a cone.

example.question: Find the total surface area of a cone with radius 7 cm and slant height 12 cm.

note: Total surface area = Curved surface area + Area of the circular base.

title: Surface Area of Sphere
description: Calculates the total surface area of a sphere.

example.question: Find the surface area of a sphere with radius 7 cm.

note: A sphere has only one continuous curved surface.

title: CSA of Hemisphere
description: Calculates the area of the curved surface of a hemisphere.

example.question: Find the curved surface area of a hemisphere with radius 7 cm.

note: Curved surface area excludes the circular base.

title: TSA of Hemisphere
description: Calculates the total surface area of a hemisphere, including its circular base.

example.question: Find the total surface area of a hemisphere with radius 7 cm.

note: Total surface area = Curved surface area + Area of the circular base.
